title: Show activity for a specific logged-in user
summary: Use `w` with a username to filter the output and see only the processes and session details for that particular user.

steps.explain: Run `w` followed by the username to see only that user's session information.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The login name of the user you want to check.

steps.expect: Output filtered to show only the specified user's login and process details.
